prerequisite_evidence.observed_result: The exact repaired backend ran under systemd in the Azure Ubuntu guest, served HTTPS while twelve raw TCP clients remained connected, and was cleaned up without changing production hashes.

targets.gate: VPN-01 local validation and backend-specific Azure probe health

authorized_guest_changes: create a root-only backup directory on the currently targeted VM
replace /opt/servicetracer-demo/backend.py with the exact tested source
replace /etc/systemd/system/servicetracer-demo-backend.service with the exact rendered unit
perform loopback and private-IP HTTPS validation
perform bounded local raw-TCP tolerance validation
capture non-secret service, journal, listener, queue, hash, UFW, certificate, and key evidence

rollback.trigger: immediate local validation failure on the currently modified VM
rollback.scope: restore only the backed-up backend.py and production unit on that same VM
rollback.service_action: daemon-reload and one restart after restoration
required_proof: rollback marker naming the failed checkpoint
not_triggered_by: Azure probe timeout after successful local validation
transaction-contract failure after successful local and probe validation

validation_contract: subscription and tenant observed during execution
resource group and VM region match westus2
both VMs are running with expected private IPs
regional compute usage captured without quota mutation
production service active and enabled before mutation
exact target backend and unit hashes installed
service and TCP/443 listener become ready through bounded polling
loopback and private-IP health payloads match backend identity and mode
twelve raw TCP connections do not starve valid HTTPS
listener receive queue remains below backlog
UFW configuration and certificate/key hashes remain unchanged
VPN-01 backend-specific DipAvailability becomes healthy before VPN-02 mutation
thirty bounded public transactions preserve the intended VPN-01 versus VPN-02 contrast
failure_behavior: Stop at the first failed gate, preserve evidence, do not rerun, and do not broaden scope. Roll back only an immediate local failure on the currently modified VM. Do not roll back a locally validated deployment merely because later Azure probe or transaction validation fails.
